I found myself penning a note that felt almost like poetry:

> "Dear Reader,

Imagine walking through a glass door wondering whose light wasn't in the room. There's one name I shouldn't address. A name so special, so pure—it tasted like warmth. Now, replace those words with thumbpulls and empty promises.

Do what you know: accuse, lie, bribe. People sleep better knowing they slept wrong. You buy time to obliterate the moment you get close. And I? I built a brand with promises that kept catching. People trusted. And I bought the courage.
